About Us
Ivanti empowers organisations to manage and secure technology smarter through our AI‑powered Ivanti Neurons platform. We help IT and Security teams reduce complexity, work proactively, and deliver better outcomes at scale for customers around the world.
Ivanti helps organisations work smarter through Autonomous Endpoint Management powered by our AI‑driven Ivanti Neurons platform—delivering better outcomes for our customers by reducing complexity and enabling proactive IT and security operations.
Role mission
Build, optimize, and scale the digital experiences that help customers discover, evaluate, and engage with Ivanti.
As a Full Stack Web Developer, you’ll turn marketing strategy and creative ideas into fast, secure, accessible, and high-performing web experiences used across Ivanti’s global digital presence.
What to expect
We’re looking for a hands-on Full Stack Web Developer with strong front-end expertise to help evolve ivanti.com and the digital experiences that support our customers throughout their journey.
You’ll work across the full web stack, from polished front-end experiences and interactive content to C#/.NET applications, CMS functionality, APIs, SQL Server, integrations, and deployment pipelines.
This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys building things that people actually see and use, while also being comfortable getting under the hood to solve complex technical problems. You’ll partner closely with Creative and Marketing teams and have the autonomy to take work from concept and implementation through launch and production support.
You don’t need to come from a perfectly modern tech stack. We’re looking for someone who can work pragmatically across established, legacy, and modern technologies while helping us continuously improve how we build for the web.
What you’ll do
Build experiences: Develop responsive, accessible, high-quality website experiences using C#, ASP.NET, MVC, Razor, JavaScript, HTML, CSS/SCSS, APIs, and SQL Server.
Bring creative ideas to life: Partner closely with Creative to turn approved designs into polished, responsive, cross-browser experiences.
Create reusable solutions: Build components, templates, campaign pages, interactive tools, and major website experiences that scale beyond one-off projects.
Develop rich interactions: Create engaging web experiences using JavaScript and GSAP, including responsive animations and scroll-based interactions.
Own the full web stack: Work across CMS configuration, application code, APIs, databases, forms, integrations, routing, caching, redirects, and third-party services.
Support our digital ecosystem: Help integrate analytics, Google Tag Manager, browser data layers, consent and privacy tooling, and other marketing technologies.
Ship confidently: Contribute to Git-based development, code reviews, Azure DevOps pipelines, testing, releases, launches, and production support.
Solve complex problems: Diagnose issues across front-end code, .NET applications, databases, APIs, IIS, Azure services, Cloudflare, caching, integrations, and traffic routing.
Own your work: Take projects from investigation and estimation through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support, communicating risks and dependencies along the way.
Build smarter with AI: Use tools such as GitHub Copilot to accelerate development, debugging, documentation, refactoring, and code review while ensuring quality, security, performance, and maintainability.
What you’ll bring
We’re looking for someone who combines strong web development fundamentals with curiosity, ownership, and a practical approach to solving problems.
Professional experience building and supporting production websites or web applications in a full-stack development role.
Strong experience with C#, ASP.NET, ASP.NET MVC, Razor, JavaScript, HTML, CSS/SCSS, and SQL Server.
Strong front-end skills, particularly responsive development, accessibility, cross-browser compatibility, and translating designs accurately into code.
Experience working with a CMS or content-managed website environment. Experience with Kentico Xperience is a plus.
Confidence working across multiple layers of a web application, from CMS configuration and browser code through APIs, application logic, and databases.
Experience with APIs, integrations, forms, HTTP behavior, caching, Git, deployment pipelines, and production releases.
Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, including the ability to get up to speed quickly with unfamiliar systems.
Clear communication skills and the ability to explain technical considerations and trade-offs to non-technical partners.
Experience using GitHub Copilot or another AI coding assistant as part of a professional development workflow.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Nice to have
You don’t need to check every box, but experience in any of the following would be valuable:
ASP.NET Web Forms
Kentico Xperience 13 or Xperience by Kentico
Vue, Nuxt or TypeScript
Tailwind CSS, jQuery, vanilla JavaScript or GSAP
Visual Studio, Visual Studio Code and GitHub
Azure DevOps, IIS, Azure Functions or Azure Storage
Cloudflare, CDN configuration, caching or traffic routing
Technical SEO, website performance and accessibility
Consent management, analytics or tag management
B2B, enterprise technology or marketing-focused websites
Why this role matters
The corporate website sits at the center of Ivanti’s digital presence, connecting customers with our products, content, campaigns, and brand.
In this role, you’ll help us move faster, build better experiences, and strengthen the technical foundation behind our digital marketing ecosystem. Your work will improve website performance and reliability, expand reusable capabilities for Marketing, and help us deliver secure, accessible, engaging experiences at scale.
Why Ivanti?
Friendly flexible working model: Empower excellence whether you’re at home or in the office and support work-life balance .
Competitive compensation & total rewards : Including health, wellness, and financial plans tailored for you and your family.
Global, diverse teams: Collaborate with talented people from 23+ countries.
Learning & development: Grow your skills with access to best-in-class learning tools and programs.
Equity & belonging: We value every voice. Your story helps inform our solutions for a changing world.
What drives us
Ivanti’s mission is to elevate human potential within organizations by managing, protecting and automating technology for continuous innovation.
It is through diverse and inclusive hiring, decision-making, and commitment to our employees and partners that we will continue to build and deliver world-class solutions for our customers.
To learn more about Ivanti’s Mission and Core Values.
Inclusion at Ivanti
Ivanti is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer . We’re committed to building a diverse team and fostering an inclusive environment where everyone belongs. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and walks of life. Need adjustments during the process? Reach out to talent@ivanti.com we’re happy to help.

A client with Kforce is seeking a Data Scientist I to join their team in San Diego, CA.

Summary:
This role owns the demand-side pipeline and dashboard day to day, working alongside the supply-side owner, and helps close reliability gaps in the planning tools the wider team depends on. It's a hands-on data engineering and analytics role: less new model-building, more owning production data products end to end - schema, pipeline logic, dashboards, and the bugs and edge cases that come with them.

Responsibilities:
 
  Own the demand-suite Qlik dashboards and their underlying Superglue pipelines: pipeline logic, schema, dashboard connections, and runbook, following handoff from Data Science & Analytics 
  Validate pipeline output against pre-migration baselines during transition, and troubleshoot discrepancies as they surface 
  Attend and contribute to bug-triage (DEFT) meetings and handle first-line escalations for owned assets once Data Science & Analytics moves to escalation-only support 
  Back up the supply-side asset owner on request, and be backed up in turn, so neither pipeline goes uncovered during absences 
  Build and maintain a defect inventory for known configuration-validation and error-handling gaps in adjacent planning tools (the ramp optimizer and expert plan tools), in support of the team's broader tooling-reliability effort 
  Track down and help resolve known open issues on these tables, including a disputed field-definition change affecting reported handle rate, an intermittent pipeline race condition, and access-tagging gaps for downstream report users 
  Partner with the outgoing Data Science & Analytics team through the transition period on lineage, documentation, and knowledge transfer 
 
 
  Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Information Systems, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience with production data pipelines and BI tooling; No advanced degree required - this role is scoped to data engineering/analytics ownership, not research 
  Strong SQL and hands-on experience with a cloud data lake/lakehouse environment (Databricks or equivalent) 
  Experience owning or maintaining production BI dashboards (Qlik strongly preferred; Other BI tools considered) 
  Experience with ETL/data pipeline tools and debugging pipeline failures (dependency/race-condition issues, schema drift, data-quality checks) 
  Comfortable working independently in a live production environment with imperfect documentation, including triaging and escalating issues under time pressure 
  Clear written and verbal communication - this role interfaces with both the outgoing data science team and business-side planning stakeholders 

 
Preferred:
 
  Experience with a pipeline orchestration tool comparable to Superglue 
  Prior experience on a data/reporting ownership handoff or migration 
  Familiarity with contact-center or workforce-management data (contact/handle-rate metrics, forecast-vs-actuals reporting, staffing or capacity planning concepts)
